data.one_liner: A highly customizable credit card input field with built-in animations and card brand detection.
data.what_it_does: Provides a credit card input component supporting card numbers, expiry dates, and CVVs. It includes built-in animations, automatic brand detection, and validation builders.
use_when: You need a dedicated credit card input form with built-in formatting and validation.
You want automatic brand detection while the user types a card number.
avoid_when: You are handling full payment gateway integration inside the package, as this is just an input field component.
strengths: Built-in collapsing animations and focus management
Extensive builder support for deep customization
weaknesses: Limited to credit card input UI rather than complete payment processing.
